newsitem.title: BELGIUM: U.K. green rate to revalue on Thursday, HGCA says.
newsitem.headline: U.K. green rate to revalue on Thursday, HGCA says.

text.p: The British green rate will revalue on Thursday to 0.720829 per Ecu from 0.742320, the U.K.'s Home Grown Cereals Authority (HGCA) said on Wednesday.
The green sterling revaluation, the third this year, follows changes on March 29 and January 21.
A revaluation of the green rate cuts the value of the amounts paid by Brussels to British farmers.
Green rates are used by the European Union to convert Ecus into the currencies of its member states for payments under the Common Agricultural Policy (CAP).
